text:
[Council File 26-1411]
Motion (Rodriguez – Jurado) relative to the Department of Animal Services’ current staffing and deployment of Animal Control Officers, and resources needed to maintain the level of services and response time to ensure the safety of animals and residents across the City.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion on the Department of Animal Services' current Animal Control Officer staffing and deployment, and the resources needed to keep service and response times at their current level.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Oct 21, 2026)
